stories.title: Kyiv residents face attacks with fewer defenses overhead
stories.summary: Another overnight attack killed at least 17 people in and around Kyiv. The strikes come as Ukraine faces a growing shortage of the interceptor missiles used to defend the capital.

stories.title: Myanmar's conflict tops 100,000 dead as junta benefits from world's inattention
stories.summary: A 2021 military coup plunged Myanmar into a brutal civil war, ousting Aung San Suu Kyi's elected government. For years, the world isolated the junta. That isolation is breaking down.

stories.title: $150 million contract to represent migrant children awarded to Trump connected Texas law firm
stories.summary: A small Texas law firm with ties to the Trump administration has been awarded a $150 million contract to represent children who cross the border without guardians.

stories.title: New Mexico is investigating Epstein's activities within state lines
stories.summary: The New Mexico attorney general is suing the U.S. Department of Justice for more information about Jeffrey Epstein and his activities at a ranch near Santa Fe.

stories.title: Dali in America
stories.summary: Spanish painter Salvador Dali needed America to become famous. So suggests a new exhibit about his life and influence.

stories.title: The tricky conversation about Ariana Grande and body image in the public eye
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Monica Hesse of the Washington Post about the cultural conversation around Ariana Grande after she appeared extremely thin in a recent music video.
